content: Tamwey yey, gunalet neiw waseg ya̱koum Gayus. Kalin nuwag avakaein ya̱koum. E, peinan Yeisuw angamag ya̱koum, singay ikalin nuwag ya̱koum.
Gwade, kululuwam tawtoun, mapuna aninitoug Yowbad waseg va̱gan bukumwa̱saw, o bukuses bwein.
Bo amwa̱saw avakaein peinan sidayas nimeis, nisekeigs liva̱neim ya̱koum, peinan amsinap mounid, bwanabwein.
E, baligen livneimiy nitug yakamiy, peinan sinap bwanabwein kuyyousis, mo bamwa̱saw avakaein.
Gwade, igaw bukulabes sidayas, o ambwabwal tasiyas bukumtakavates, singay bwein muwotet towen.

Tasiyas asilivan, ilansa, “Mtowen Gayus singay tasiwa̱youb wasigeis yakamey.” Asilivan ma̱wan nisekemas yakamey tayakelesiys. E, sidayas binounas, kadiloka bukutanes bwein, peinan takanaweins Yowbad aygan tasiyas.
Tasiyas bo ilisawes siven silma̱nin Yowbad nawotet; tage nag ininitougs kaeis wasigeis siyas tadadubs, nag.
Kadiloka bitalabes sidayas, idawotets katanok silma̱nin sinap bwanabwein.
Sinap kweitan nalel wagunalet niwekeimiy tayakelesiys yakamiy, tage towen Diyotilep ikaypom kaleiwag, isilbwed gunakaleiwag.

Igaw baw, mo bakamtel ansinap towen kalbaleb, o bakamtel anilivan towen makava ivtokeig livan. E, ansinap kwayuwein kalbaleb peinan nag itam sidayas tayekelesiys, o isilbwed siked tasiyas kalisiy sivines beitams tayekelesiys tasiyas wasigeis, mo ibob siyekelesiy ineis wamnat.
Gwade, awoum kwabkun sinap kalbaleb; sinap bwanabwein kwabkun. Toubweins tasiyas Yowbad angamag; tage takalbalebs nag ikakins Yowbad.
Dimitil ansinap bwein. Sidayas babaw iliva̱nes ma̱wan. Tasiyas asisinap mounid ilivans, ilansa, “Mtowen ansinap bwein.” Yey alivan ma̱wan, o kukwakins agulivan mounid.
Sivinag sinap babaw badibakeim, tage nag balel mulet waseg; peinan adok nuwanaw baw, mo bitakaypul soug yak, bitalivan aditeiy.
Kalin nuwag ya̱koum. Sidayas wamapalatan ikalin nuwes waseg yak. Agulivan siwa̱youb kusekes sidayas katanok katanok wasigeis. Taneim-o. Yey Yon.
